internal_collaboration.evidence_quote: Welcome to Scoil Mhuire Allenwood. We are a Catholic, mixed School located in the village of Allenwood and we currently have 267 students in the school. Our school opened in August 2017 after the amalgamation of Allenwood BNS and Allenwood GNS. We currently have two buildings. The front building, formerly known as Allenwood BNS, was built in 1929. The back building, formerly Allenwood GNS, was built in 1957. We welcome children from the local catchment area of all faiths and nationalities.
